title: Card Pack Hunter – A free browser-based trading card collecting game
author: No-Possibility1721
selftext:
I've been working on a little project called Card Pack Hunter, and I'd love to share it with people who enjoy collecting games.

It's a free online trading card game where you open booster packs, hunt for rare cards, build your own collection and trade duplicates with other players.

Some of the things you can do:

\\- Open themed booster packs and hunt for rare and legendary cards.

\\- Build your own binder and complete card collections.

\\- Trade cards with other players through the marketplace.

\\- Battle other collectors in the Arena.

\\- Take part in community boss raids.

\\- Unlock achievements and climb the rankings.

\\- Collect companions and earn extra rewards.

The game is completely free. There are no ads, no NFTs, no crypto and no real-money purchases. Everything is earned through playing, and the cards have no real-world monetary value.

A quick note about the artwork: I currently use AI-generated and AI-assisted art for the card illustrations. It's what makes it possible for me to keep expanding the project on my current budget. In the future, when the budget allows, I'd really like to collaborate with human artists and bring more artists into the project.

This is an independent project that I work on in my spare time, mainly because I enjoy building things and love the feeling of opening packs and collecting cards.

You can try it here:

[https://cardpackhunter.com/](https://cardpackhunter.com/)

I'd be happy to hear what you think!
